revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Wiring the Studio
revealWordProblem.text: A recording studio runs cables for its microphones. The cost of wiring one room is the expression 5x + 7 + 3x + 2, where x is the number of microphones in that room. Write the cost as a simplified expression by combining like terms. Then find the total cost when the room has x = 4 microphones.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Combine like terms: 5x + 3x = 8x and 7 + 2 = 9, so the simplified expression is 8x + 9. When x = 4, the cost is 8(4) + 9 = 32 + 9 = 41 dollars.

vocabulary.definition: Rewrite an expression in a shorter equivalent form by combining like terms and using properties.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Reescribir una expresión en una forma equivalente más corta combinando términos semejantes y usando propiedades.
vocabulary.cloze: Combine ___ ___ to write a shorter expression with the same value.

examples.why: The 4 has no x and cannot join.

vocabulary.definition: Terms with the same letter raised to the same power, like 2x and 5x.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Términos con la misma letra elevada a la misma potencia, como 2x y 5x.
vocabulary.visual: 5x and 3x are like terms (both x); 5x and 5y are NOT (different variables); 2x and 2x² are NOT (different powers)
vocabulary.cloze: Terms with the same variable part, like 3y and 8y, are ___.

examples.why: They share the same variable y.
They have different variables, so they are not like terms.

vocabulary.definition: To add or subtract terms with the same letter into one.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Sumar o restar términos con la misma letra en uno solo.
vocabulary.visual: 8m + 3m = 11m — add the coefficients (8 + 3 = 11) and keep the variable (m)
vocabulary.cloze: To add or subtract like terms into a single term is to ___ them.

examples.why: A constant cannot join a variable term.

vocabulary.definition: To rewrite an expression in a shorter form that is still equal to the original.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Reescribir una expresión en una forma más corta que sigue siendo igual a la original.
vocabulary.visual: 2a + 5a + 3 simplifies to 7a + 3 — the two a-terms combine, the constant stays
vocabulary.cloze: Rewriting an expression in a shorter form that is still equal to it is to ___ it.

examples.why: Like terms combine; the constant stays.
The 3 is a constant, not an a-term.

vocabulary.definition: The number in front of a letter, like the 3 in 3x.
vocabulary.definitionEs: El número frente a una letra, como el 3 en 3x.
vocabulary.visual: In 9x, the coefficient is 9 — it tells you 'nine groups of x'; if x = 2, then 9x = 18
vocabulary.cloze: The number multiplied by a variable is the ___.

vocabulary.definition: A single number, variable, or product of them, separated by + or − signs.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Un solo número, variable o producto de ellos, separado por signos + o −.
vocabulary.cloze: A number or variable separated by + or − signs is a ___.

examples.why: That separates terms; it is not one.

vocabulary.definition: Multiplying a number by everything inside the parentheses: a(b + c) = ab + ac.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Multiplicar un número por todo lo que está dentro del paréntesis: a(b + c) = ab + ac.
vocabulary.cloze: Multiplying each part of a sum by a number uses the ___ property.

launch.narrative: The music studio is placing supply orders for three rehearsal rooms. Room A needs 4 microphones and 3 stands. Room B needs 2 microphones and 5 stands. Room C needs 6 microphones and 1 stand. Instead of ordering separately, you can combine: (4 + 2 + 6) microphones and (3 + 5 + 1) stands = 12 microphones and 9 stands. That's simplifying by combining like items!

conceptIntro.heading: How do we simplify by combining like terms?
conceptIntro.intro: Like terms are terms with the same variable, like 2x and 5x. To simplify an expression, you add or subtract the like terms to make it shorter.
conceptIntro.keyIdea: Combining Like Terms. 1. Like Terms: Terms that share the exact same variable part and exponent (e.g. 4x and 2x). 2. Add or subtract the coefficients of like terms; keep the variable unchanged. 3. Constants (numbers without variables) combine together separately

iDo.title: Watch me
lines: The rooms need microphones and stands: (4 + 2 + 6) microphones and (3 + 5 + 1) stands.
Microphones are like items, so I add: 4 + 2 + 6 = 12 microphones.
Stands are like items, so I add: 3 + 5 + 1 = 9 stands.
In algebra this is the same as 4m + 2m + 6m + 3s + 5s + 1s = 12m + 9s.
linesEs: Los salones necesitan micrófonos y atriles: (4 + 2 + 6) micrófonos y (3 + 5 + 1) atriles.
Los micrófonos son cosas semejantes, así que sumo: 4 + 2 + 6 = 12 micrófonos.
Los atriles son cosas semejantes, así que sumo: 3 + 5 + 1 = 9 atriles.
En álgebra esto es lo mismo que 4m + 2m + 6m + 3a + 5a + 1a = 12m + 9a.

weDo.title: Let's try together
lines: Let's simplify 5x + 3x. Are these like terms?
Yes, both have x, so we add the numbers in front: 5 + 3 = 8.
linesEs: Sí, los dos tienen x, así que sumamos los números de adelante: 5 + 3 = 8.

youDo.title: Now it's your turn
lines: Sort the terms into like terms and not-like terms in the activity.
Remember: only terms with the same variable can be combined.
linesEs: En la actividad, clasifica los términos en semejantes y no semejantes.
Recuerda: solo se pueden combinar los términos que tienen la misma variable.

conceptIntro.introEs: Los términos semejantes son términos con la misma variable, como 2x y 5x. Para simplificar una expresión, sumas o restas los términos semejantes para hacerla más corta.
conceptIntro.keyIdeaEs: Combinar términos semejantes. 1. Términos semejantes: términos que comparten exactamente la misma parte variable y el mismo exponente (por ejemplo, 4x y 2x). 2. Suma o resta los coeficientes de los términos semejantes; deja la variable igual. 3. Las constantes (números sin variable) se combinan por separado

explore.instructions: Identify the like terms in each expression. Group the terms that can be combined.

discourse.prompt: What rule determines whether two terms are 'like terms'? Why can't you combine unlike terms?
discourse.sentenceFrame: Two terms are like terms when they have the same ___. You cannot combine ___ and ___ because they represent different ___.

optional.stem: The board shows 3x + 5x on one channel. Simplify it.
optional.explanation: 3x and 5x are like terms, so add the coefficients: 3 + 5 = 8. The variable x stays, giving 8x.
choiceFeedback: 3x and 5x are like terms. Add the coefficients: 3 + 5 = 8. Result: 8x.
Did you multiply 3 × 5? You're adding like terms, not multiplying.
Both have x, so combine: 3x + 5x = 8x.
optional.stemEs: El tablero muestra 3x + 5x en un canal. Simplifícalo.
optional.explanationEs: 3x y 5x son términos semejantes, así que suma los coeficientes: 3 + 5 = 8. La variable x se queda, lo que da 8x.
hints: Like terms have exactly the same variable part, so 3x and 5x can be combined.
Add the numbers in front of the variable and keep the variable itself unchanged.
The coefficients here are 3 and 5. Add those two numbers, then attach the x to your result.
hintsEs: Los términos semejantes tienen exactamente la misma parte variable, así que 3x y 5x se pueden combinar.
Suma los números que están delante de la variable y deja la variable igual.
Aquí los coeficientes son 3 y 5. Suma esos dos números y luego pega la x a tu resultado.

optional.explanation: 4a + a = 5a (remember a means 1a). The 2 has no like term, so it stays. Result: 5a + 2.
choiceFeedback: 4a and a are like terms: 4a + a = 5a. Keep the 2 separate.
Adding like terms does not create a new exponent. 4a + a still has a to the first power.
It looks like you combined the 2 with the terms that have a. The 2 has no variable, so it is not a like term with 4a or a.
optional.explanationEs: 4a + a = 5a (recuerda que a significa 1a). El 2 no tiene término semejante, así que se queda. Resultado: 5a + 2.
hints: Only terms with the same variable can be combined; a plain number stays on its own.
Remember that a by itself means 1a, so line it up with the 4a.
Add the coefficients of 4a and 1a, and leave the 2 exactly where it is.
hintsEs: Solo se pueden combinar los términos con la misma variable; un número solo se queda aparte.
Recuerda que a sola significa 1a, así que alinéala con 4a.
Suma los coeficientes de 4a y 1a, y deja el 2 exactamente donde está.

optional.explanation: Subtract the coefficients of the like terms: 7 − 3 = 4. Keep the variable y, giving 4y.
choiceFeedback: 7y and 3y are like terms. 7y − 3y = 4y.
Subtract the coefficients: 7 − 3 = 4. The variable stays y.
Combine: 7y minus 3y gives 4y.
optional.explanationEs: Resta los coeficientes de los términos semejantes: 7 − 3 = 4. Conserva la variable y, lo que da 4y.
hints: 7y and 3y are like terms because they share the same variable y.
Subtract the coefficients and keep the variable attached to your answer.
The coefficients are 7 and 3. Subtract them, then write the y back onto the result.
hintsEs: 7y y 3y son términos semejantes porque comparten la misma variable y.
Resta los coeficientes y mantén la variable pegada a tu respuesta.
Los coeficientes son 7 y 3. Réstalos y luego vuelve a escribir la y en el resultado.

optional.explanation: 6m + 3m = 9m. The constant 4 has no like term, so it stays. Result: 9m + 4.
choiceFeedback: 6m and 3m are like terms: 6m + 3m = 9m. Keep 4 separate.
Did you combine 9 + 4? Like terms are 6m and 3m. Constants stay separate.
It looks like you added the 4 in with the terms that have m. The 4 has no variable, so it cannot be combined with 6m or 3m.
optional.explanationEs: 6m + 3m = 9m. La constante 4 no tiene término semejante, así que se queda. Resultado: 9m + 4.
hints: Sort the expression first: which terms carry an m, and which one is just a number?
Combine only the m terms; the constant has no partner, so it stays as it is.
Add the coefficients 6 and 3 to build the m term, then write the + 4 after it.
hintsEs: Primero clasifica la expresión: ¿cuáles términos llevan m y cuál es solo un número?
Combina únicamente los términos con m; la constante no tiene pareja, así que se queda igual.
Suma los coeficientes 6 y 3 para armar el término con m y luego escribe el + 4 después.

optional.instructions: The terms are scattered across the mixing board. Sort each term into its like-term group so you know what can be combined.

categories.label: x-terms (have the variable x)
categories.labelEs: Términos con x (tienen la variable x)

optional.explanation: The terms 3x, 5x, and 2x all carry the variable x, so they belong together and could be combined into 10x. The tiles 7, 4, and 9 have no variable at all, which makes them constants — they combine with each other but never with the x-terms.
optional.explanationEs: Los términos 3x, 5x y 2x llevan la variable x, así que van juntos y se podrían combinar en 10x. Las fichas 7, 4 y 9 no tienen ninguna variable, y eso las hace constantes: se combinan entre sí, pero nunca con los términos con x.
hints: Like terms share the same variable part, so a term carrying an x can never sit in the same group as a plain number.
Check each tile for a letter: if you see an x, it joins the x-terms; if it is only a number, it is a constant.
Start with 3x: it has the variable x, so it goes in the x-terms group. Now run the same check on the tile that says 7.
hintsEs: Los términos semejantes comparten la misma parte con variable, así que un término que lleva x nunca puede estar en el mismo grupo que un número solo.
Revisa cada ficha buscando una letra: si ves una x, va con los términos con x; si es solo un número, es una constante.
Empieza con 3x: tiene la variable x, así que va en el grupo de términos con x. Ahora haz la misma revisión con la ficha que dice 7.
optional.instructionsEs: Los términos están regados por la consola de mezcla. Clasifica cada término en su grupo de términos semejantes para saber qué se puede combinar.

optional.title: Level 2 Extension — Crossed Channels on the Board
optional.correctWork: 3x and 5 are NOT like terms — 3x has the variable x and 5 is a constant with no variable. They cannot be combined. The expression 3x + 5 is already in simplest form. Writing 8x is wrong because it changes the value (at x = 2, 3x + 5 = 11 but 8x = 16).
hints: Do 3x and 5 have the same variable part? One has x and the other has no variable.
You can only combine like terms. A variable term and a plain number stay separate, so 3x + 5 cannot be shortened.
optional.titleEs: Extensión de Nivel 2 — canales cruzados en la consola
optional.explanation: The Combine step added the 3 and the 5, but 3x has the variable x while 5 has none, so they are not like terms. Nothing can be combined here — 3x + 5 is already in simplest form, and writing 8x changes the value (at x = 2 it gives 16 instead of 11).
optional.explanationEs: El paso de combinar sumó el 3 y el 5, pero 3x tiene la variable x y el 5 no tiene ninguna, así que no son términos semejantes. Aquí no se puede combinar nada: 3x + 5 ya está en su forma más simple, y escribir 8x cambia el valor (con x = 2 da 16 en lugar de 11).
optional.correctWorkEs: 3x y 5 NO son términos semejantes — 3x tiene la variable x y 5 es una constante sin variable. No pueden combinarse. La expresión 3x + 5 ya está en su forma más simple. Escribir 8x está mal porque cambia el valor (en x = 2, 3x + 5 = 11 pero 8x = 16).
hintsEs: ¿3x y 5 tienen la misma parte variable? Uno tiene x y el otro no tiene variable.
Solo puedes combinar términos semejantes. Un término con variable y un número solo se quedan separados, así que 3x + 5 no se puede acortar.

choiceFeedback: 7x and 3x are like terms. 7 + 3 = 10. Result: 10x.
Did you multiply 7 × 3? Add the coefficients: 7 + 3 = 10.
Same variable x: add the coefficients 7 + 3 = 10.
hints: 7x and 3x have the same variable x, so they're like terms and can combine.
Add the coefficients; the x stays exactly the same — no squaring, no multiplying coefficients.
Compute 7 + 3 and place that sum in front of x.
hintsEs: 7x y 3x tienen la misma variable x, así que son términos semejantes y se pueden combinar.
Suma los coeficientes; la x se queda exactamente igual: no se eleva al cuadrado ni se multiplican los coeficientes.
Calcula 7 + 3 y pon esa suma delante de x.

approaching.explanation: 9n + 2n = 11n. The constant 4 has no like term, so it stays. Result: 11n + 4.
choiceFeedback: 9n and 2n are like terms: 9 + 2 = 11. Keep 4 separate.
4 is a constant term; 11n is the combined variable term.
You stuck the digits 9 and 2 together instead of adding them. Like terms are combined by adding the coefficients: 9 + 2.
hints: There are two n-terms (9n and 2n) and one lonely constant (4) with no partner.
Combine only the like terms; the constant 4 stays separate in your answer.
Add 9n + 2n by adding 9 + 2. The 4 keeps its own spot at the end.
approaching.explanationEs: 9n + 2n = 11n. La constante 4 no tiene término semejante, así que se queda. Resultado: 11n + 4.
hintsEs: Hay dos términos con n (9n y 2n) y una constante solitaria (4) sin pareja.
Combina solo los términos semejantes; la constante 4 se queda aparte en tu respuesta.
Suma 9n + 2n sumando 9 + 2. El 4 conserva su propio lugar al final.

approaching.explanation: 6x and 2x are like terms because they both have the same variable (x) raised to the same power (1).
choiceFeedback: Like terms have the same variable raised to the same power.
6x and 6y have different variables, so they're not like terms.
x and x² are different (different powers), so not like terms.
hints: Like terms need the exact same variable raised to the exact same power.
Compare two things in each pair: the letter itself and the small exponent on it. Both must match exactly.
Check each pair in order: same letter, and the same small exponent on it? Both must match.
approaching.explanationEs: 6x y 2x son términos semejantes porque los dos tienen la misma variable (x) elevada a la misma potencia (1).
hintsEs: Los términos semejantes necesitan exactamente la misma variable elevada exactamente a la misma potencia.
Compara dos cosas en cada pareja: la letra y el pequeño exponente sobre ella. Ambos deben coincidir exactamente.
Prueba la primera pareja: 6x y 2x — ¿misma letra? ¿misma potencia? Si ambas coinciden, son semejantes.

choiceFeedback: 5a and 2a are like terms: 5 + 2 = 7. Keep 3 separate.
Did you add all numbers? Like terms: 5a + 2a = 7a. Constant: 3.
You glued the digits 5 and 2 together instead of adding them. Add the coefficients of the like terms: 5 + 2.
hints: Spot the like terms: 5a and 2a share the variable a. The 3 has no variable.
Combine the a-terms by adding their coefficients; carry the 3 along unchanged.
Add 5 + 2 for the a coefficient, then write the constant 3 after it.
hintsEs: Identifica los términos semejantes: 5a y 2a comparten la variable a. El 3 no tiene variable.
Combina los términos con a sumando sus coeficientes; el 3 se lleva sin cambios.
Suma 5 + 2 para el coeficiente de a y luego escribe la constante 3 después.

approaching.instructions: Sort each pair of terms by whether they are like terms (can be combined) or not.
hints: Like terms match in BOTH the variable letter and its exponent. Plain numbers only pair with plain numbers.
For each card ask two questions: same letter? Same power? Two yes answers = like terms.
First card: 4m and 7m — both use m to the first power, so they can combine. Place it, then quiz the next pair.
approaching.explanation: Terms are alike only when the variable AND its exponent match: 4m and 7m, 5n and n, and 6a and 9a all pass that test. The pairs 3x and 3y use different letters, 8 and 2p pair a constant with a variable term, and 2x² and 2x use different exponents, so none of those can be combined.
approaching.explanationEs: Los términos son semejantes solo cuando coinciden la variable Y su exponente: 4m y 7m, 5n y n, y 6a y 9a pasan esa prueba. Los pares 3x y 3y usan letras distintas, 8 y 2p juntan una constante con un término con variable, y 2x² y 2x usan exponentes distintos, así que ninguno de esos se puede combinar.
approaching.instructionsEs: Clasifica cada pareja de términos según si son términos semejantes (se pueden combinar) o no.
hintsEs: Los términos semejantes coinciden TANTO en la letra como en el exponente. Los números simples solo se juntan con números simples.
En cada tarjeta hazte dos preguntas: ¿misma letra? ¿misma potencia? Dos síes = términos semejantes.
Primera tarjeta: 4m y 7m — ambos usan m a la primera potencia, así que se pueden combinar. Colócala y evalúa la siguiente pareja.

approaching.title: Spot the Mistake — Exponent Slip
approaching.correctWork: 4x and 3x are like terms, so add the coefficients 4 + 3 = 7 and KEEP the variable exactly as it is: the answer is 7x, not 7x². Adding like terms never changes the exponent on the variable. (Check: at x = 2, 4x + 3x = 8 + 6 = 14, and 7x = 14, but 7x² = 28.)
hints: When you add like terms, does the little exponent on x change?
4x + 3x means 7 groups of x, which is 7x. The exponent stays at 1.
approaching.titleEs: Descubre el error — resbalón con el exponente
approaching.explanation: Adding the coefficients 4 + 3 = 7 was right, but the Simplify step also changed x into x². Combining like terms only counts how many x's you have, so 4x + 3x = 7x — check it at x = 2, where 8 + 6 = 14 matches 7x but not 7x² = 28.
approaching.explanationEs: Sumar los coeficientes 4 + 3 = 7 estuvo bien, pero el paso de simplificar también cambió x por x². Combinar términos semejantes solo cuenta cuántas x tienes, así que 4x + 3x = 7x; compruébalo con x = 2, donde 8 + 6 = 14 coincide con 7x pero no con 7x² = 28.
approaching.correctWorkEs: 4x y 3x son términos semejantes, así que suma los coeficientes 4 + 3 = 7 y CONSERVA la variable tal como está: la respuesta es 7x, no 7x². Sumar términos semejantes nunca cambia el exponente de la variable. (Comprueba: en x = 2, 4x + 3x = 8 + 6 = 14, y 7x = 14, pero 7x² = 28.)
hintsEs: Cuando sumas términos semejantes, ¿cambia el exponente pequeño de la x?
4x + 3x significa 7 grupos de x, o sea 7x. El exponente sigue siendo 1.

onLevel.instructions: Simplify each expression by combining like terms.
hints: Row 1 shows the move: gather the matching variable terms first, then bring the constant along.
For each row, underline the variable terms and circle the constants. Combine each group separately.
Row 2: 6x + 4 + 2x + 7 — pair 6x with 2x, and 4 with 7. Add each pair, then write both parts.
onLevel.explanation: In each row you combine the variable terms and the constants separately: 3a + 5a = 8a leaves 8a + 2; 6x + 2x = 8x with 4 + 7 = 11 gives 8x + 11; 10m − 3m = 7m gives 7m + 5; and 4y + y = 5y with 3 + 9 = 12 gives 5y + 12. The constants never merge with the variable terms because they have no variable.
onLevel.explanationEs: En cada fila combinas por separado los términos con variable y las constantes: 3a + 5a = 8a deja 8a + 2; 6x + 2x = 8x con 4 + 7 = 11 da 8x + 11; 10m − 3m = 7m da 7m + 5; y 4y + y = 5y con 3 + 9 = 12 da 5y + 12. Las constantes nunca se unen con los términos con variable porque no tienen variable.
onLevel.instructionsEs: Simplifica cada expresión combinando los términos semejantes.
hintsEs: La fila 1 muestra el movimiento: junta primero los términos con la misma variable y luego lleva la constante.
Para cada fila, subraya los términos con variable y encierra las constantes. Combina cada grupo por separado.
Fila 2: 6x + 4 + 2x + 7 — junta 6x con 2x, y 4 con 7. Suma cada pareja y luego escribe ambas partes.

onLevel.label: Match each expression to its simplified form.
hints: Simplify each left card before matching — combine like terms while watching the + and − signs.
Handle the variable terms first, then the constants. A minus sign belongs to the term right after it.
Start with 8x + 3x + 1: add 8 + 3 for the x-part and keep the + 1. Find the card that shows both.
onLevel.explanation: Each match comes from combining like terms and carrying the signs: 8x + 3x + 1 = 11x + 1, 5a − 2a + 7 = 3a + 7, 4n + n + 6 = 5n + 6 (the lone n counts as 1n), 12y − 5y = 7y, 3m + 4m = 7m with 8 + 2 = 10 for 7m + 10, and 9p − 3p = 6p leaves 6p + 1.
onLevel.explanationEs: Cada pareja sale de combinar términos semejantes llevando los signos: 8x + 3x + 1 = 11x + 1, 5a − 2a + 7 = 3a + 7, 4n + n + 6 = 5n + 6 (la n sola cuenta como 1n), 12y − 5y = 7y, 3m + 4m = 7m con 8 + 2 = 10 para 7m + 10, y 9p − 3p = 6p deja 6p + 1.
onLevel.labelEs: Une cada expresión con su forma simplificada.
hintsEs: Simplifica cada tarjeta de la izquierda antes de unir: combina términos semejantes cuidando los signos + y −.
Trabaja primero los términos con variable y luego las constantes. Un signo menos pertenece al término que le sigue.
Empieza con 8x + 3x + 1: suma 8 + 3 para la parte de x y conserva el + 1. Busca la tarjeta que muestre ambas.

onLevel.instructions: Simplify each expression, then sort by whether the simplified coefficient of the variable is greater than 6 or not.
hints: Combine the like terms first. The coefficient is the number left in front of the variable — that's what you compare with 6.
Verify the card's math (add or subtract the coefficients), then ask: more than 6, or 6 or less?
First card: 4x + 5x → 4 + 5 = 9. Is 9 greater than 6? Place it, then verify the next card.
onLevel.explanation: Combining like terms gives each card's coefficient, and that number is what you compare to 6: 9x, 8a, and 7y are all greater than 6, while 5n, 3m, and 5p (from 6p − p, since the lone p is 1p) are 6 or less. Only the coefficient changes when you combine — the variable stays the same.
onLevel.explanationEs: Combinar términos semejantes da el coeficiente de cada tarjeta, y ese número es el que comparas con 6: 9x, 8a y 7y son mayores que 6, mientras que 5n, 3m y 5p (de 6p − p, porque la p sola es 1p) son 6 o menos. Solo cambia el coeficiente cuando combinas; la variable se queda igual.
onLevel.instructionsEs: Simplifica cada expresión y después clasifícalas según si el coeficiente simplificado de la variable es mayor que 6 o no.
hintsEs: Cada tarjeta ya muestra el término simplificado y su coeficiente: ese es el número que comparas con 6.
Verifica las cuentas de la tarjeta (suma o resta los coeficientes) y luego pregunta: ¿más de 6, o 6 o menos?
Primera tarjeta: 4x + 5x → 4 + 5 = 9. ¿Es 9 mayor que 6? Colócala y verifica la siguiente tarjeta.

onLevel.instructions: Are these equivalent? Simplify both sides. Left: 3x + 4x + 2. Right: 7x + 2.
onLevel.label: Both simplify to 7x + 2 — they are equivalent.
onLevel.hint: Identify which terms have the same variable and power, then combine their coefficients.
hints: The right side is already simple. Simplify the left side and see if it becomes the same expression.
Combine the like terms 3x and 4x; leave the + 2 alone. Then compare with the right side term by term.
Add the coefficients 3 + 4 on the left. Does the result match the 7 in 7x + 2?
onLevel.explanation: The left side has like terms 3x and 4x, which combine into 7x, and the + 2 stays as it is, so the left side becomes 7x + 2 — exactly the right side. Since both sides simplify to the same expression, they are equivalent and the scale balances for every value of x.
onLevel.explanationEs: El lado izquierdo tiene los términos semejantes 3x y 4x, que se combinan en 7x, y el + 2 se queda igual, así que el lado izquierdo queda 7x + 2, exactamente el lado derecho. Como los dos lados se simplifican a la misma expresión, son equivalentes y la balanza queda equilibrada para cualquier valor de x.

onLevel.title: Spot the Mistake — Swept-Up Constant
onLevel.correctWork: The 4 is a constant with no variable, so it cannot be combined with the x-terms. Combine only the like terms: 6x + 2x = 8x, and the 4 stays on its own. The correct simplified expression is 8x + 4. (Check: at x = 1, 6x + 4 + 2x = 6 + 4 + 2 = 12, and 8x + 4 = 12, but 12x = 12 only by accident — at x = 2 it gives 24 instead of the true 20.)
hints: Is 4 a like term with 6x and 2x? It has no variable, so it cannot join them.
Combine the x-terms first (6x + 2x = 8x), then write the leftover constant: 8x + 4.
onLevel.titleEs: Descubre el error — la constante arrastrada
onLevel.explanation: The Combine step swept the constant 4 in with the coefficients 6 and 2, but 4 has no variable, so it is not a like term. Only 6x + 2x = 8x combine, and the 4 stays on its own, giving 8x + 4 — at x = 2 that is 20, while 12x would give 24.
onLevel.explanationEs: El paso de combinar arrastró la constante 4 junto con los coeficientes 6 y 2, pero el 4 no tiene variable, así que no es un término semejante. Solo se combinan 6x + 2x = 8x, y el 4 se queda aparte, lo que da 8x + 4; con x = 2 eso es 20, mientras que 12x daría 24.
onLevel.correctWorkEs: El 4 es una constante sin variable, así que no puede combinarse con los términos con x. Combina solo los términos semejantes: 6x + 2x = 8x, y el 4 se queda solo. La expresión simplificada correcta es 8x + 4. (Comprueba: en x = 1, 6x + 4 + 2x = 6 + 4 + 2 = 12, y 8x + 4 = 12, pero 12x = 12 solo por casualidad — en x = 2 da 24 en lugar del verdadero 20.)
hintsEs: ¿4 es un término semejante a 6x y 2x? No tiene variable, así que no puede unirse a ellos.
Combina primero los términos con x (6x + 2x = 8x), luego escribe la constante que sobra: 8x + 4.

extending.title: Find the Simplification Error
extending.correctWork: 5x + 4x = 9x (like terms). 2y stays separate (no other y-term). The constant 3 stays. Correct answer: 9x + 2y + 3. You cannot combine x-terms and y-terms into xy.
hints: Can you combine 5x and 2y? Do they have the same variable?
Like terms must have the exact same variable. 5x and 4x are like terms, but 5x and 2y are not.
extending.explanation: The Simplify step merged the x-terms and the y-term into 11xy, but terms with different variables can never be combined. Only 5x + 4x = 9x are like terms; 2y and the constant 3 each stand alone, so the expression simplifies to 9x + 2y + 3.
extending.explanationEs: El paso de simplificar juntó los términos con x y el término con y en 11xy, pero los términos con variables distintas nunca se pueden combinar. Solo 5x + 4x = 9x son términos semejantes; 2y y la constante 3 quedan cada uno por su lado, así que la expresión se simplifica a 9x + 2y + 3.
extending.correctWorkEs: 5x + 4x = 9x (términos semejantes). 2y se queda aparte (no hay otro término con y). La constante 3 se queda. Respuesta correcta: 9x + 2y + 3. No puedes combinar términos con x y términos con y en xy.
hintsEs: ¿Puedes combinar 5x y 2y? ¿Tienen la misma variable?
Los términos semejantes deben tener exactamente la misma variable. 5x y 4x son semejantes, pero 5x y 2y no.

extending.prompt: Three students simplified 4x + 3 + 2x + 5 + x differently. Student A got 7x + 8. Student B got 7x² + 8. Student C got 6x + 9. Who is correct? Explain the mistakes the other two students made.
extending.sentenceFrame: Student ___ is correct because 4x + 2x + x = ___x and 3 + 5 = ___. Student ___'s error was ___. Student ___'s error was ___.
extending.hint: Find and combine all like terms by adding or subtracting their coefficients.
hints: Count carefully: there are THREE x-terms (4x, 2x, and the lone x, which counts as 1x) and two constants (3, 5).
Simplify the expression yourself first, then compare your result to each student's answer to find the errors.
Add the three x coefficients (remember the lone x is 1x), then the constants. Compare with each student's work.
extending.explanation: Student A is correct: 4x + 2x + x = 7x (the lone x counts as 1x) and 3 + 5 = 8, giving 7x + 8. Student B added the coefficients correctly but changed x into x², which combining like terms never does, and Student C left out the lone x and instead pulled a 1 into the constants, landing on 6x + 9.
extending.explanationEs: El estudiante A tiene razón: 4x + 2x + x = 7x (la x sola cuenta como 1x) y 3 + 5 = 8, lo que da 7x + 8. El estudiante B sumó bien los coeficientes pero cambió x por x², algo que combinar términos semejantes nunca hace, y el estudiante C dejó fuera la x sola y en cambio metió un 1 en las constantes, llegando a 6x + 9.
extending.promptEs: Tres estudiantes simplificaron 4x + 3 + 2x + 5 + x de maneras diferentes. El estudiante A obtuvo 7x + 8. El estudiante B obtuvo 7x² + 8. El estudiante C obtuvo 6x + 9. ¿Quién tiene razón? Explica los errores que cometieron los otros dos.
hintsEs: Cuenta con cuidado: hay TRES términos con x (4x, 2x y la x sola, que cuenta como 1x) y dos constantes (3, 5).
Simplifica tú mismo la expresión primero y luego compara tu resultado con la respuesta de cada estudiante para hallar los errores.
Suma los tres coeficientes de x (recuerda que la x sola es 1x) y luego las constantes. Compara con el trabajo de cada estudiante.

extending.instructions: Simplify each multi-variable expression. Only combine like terms (same variable).
hints: There are two different variables per row. x-terms only combine with x-terms, y-terms only with y-terms.
Sort each row into groups by letter (plus a constants group), then add or subtract within each group only.
Row 1: group 3x with 5x, and 2y with y (that's 1y). Combine each pair and write both results.
extending.explanation: Each row groups terms by letter and combines only within a group: 3x + 5x = 8x with 2y + y = 3y gives 8x + 3y; 7a − 2a = 5a with 4b + b = 5b gives 5a + 5b; and 6m + 2m = 8m with the lone n and 3 + 1 = 4 gives 8m + n + 4. A variable with no partner, like n, simply stays as it is.
extending.explanationEs: Cada fila agrupa los términos por letra y combina solo dentro de cada grupo: 3x + 5x = 8x con 2y + y = 3y da 8x + 3y; 7a − 2a = 5a con 4b + b = 5b da 5a + 5b; y 6m + 2m = 8m con la n sola y 3 + 1 = 4 da 8m + n + 4. Una variable sin pareja, como n, simplemente se queda igual.
extending.instructionsEs: Simplifica cada expresión con varias variables. Combina solo los términos semejantes (la misma variable).
hintsEs: Hay dos variables distintas por fila. Los términos con x solo se combinan con términos con x, y los de y solo con los de y.
Clasifica cada fila en grupos por letra (más un grupo de constantes) y luego suma o resta solo dentro de cada grupo.
Fila 1: agrupa 3x con 5x, y 2y con y (que es 1y). Combina cada pareja y escribe ambos resultados.

optionalActivity.name: Combine Like Terms Studio Clean-Up
optionalActivity.intro: Tidy up the mixing board by combining like terms until every track reads in its simplest form.

practice.commonMistake: A common mistake in Simplify Algebraic Expressions is sweeping a constant into the variable terms — for example, simplifying 6x + 4 + 2x as 12x by adding all three numbers (6 + 4 + 2 = 12) instead of recognizing that 4 has no variable and cannot combine with 6x and 2x. The correct simplified expression is 8x + 4 (combine 6x + 2x = 8x, and let the 4 stay on its own). Before you submit, check that every term you combined has the exact same variable part.

diagram.title: Combining the Festival Cable Order
diagram.caption: Each row holds one type of term: add the m-parts (8+3+4=15m) and the number-parts (5+7+2=14) separately to get 15m + 14.

connect.scenario: A music festival needs supplies for 3 stages. Stage 1 needs 8m + 5 cables, Stage 2 needs 3m + 7 cables, and Stage 3 needs 4m + 2 cables, where m represents the number of microphones per stage. The total order is (8m + 5) + (3m + 7) + (4m + 2).
connect.promptQuestion: Simplify the total order expression. What does each part of the simplified expression tell you?
connect.prompt: The total order simplifies to ___m + ___. The ___ tells us ___ and the ___ tells us ___.

check.explanation: Add the m-terms: 8m + 3m + 4m = 15m. Add the constants: 5 + 7 + 2 = 14. 15m and 14 are unlike terms, so they cannot be combined.

check.stem: What does the 15m tell the festival?
choices: 15 cables are needed for every microphone
check.explanation: 15 is the coefficient of m, so for each microphone the festival needs 15 cables across all three stages.

check.stem: If each stage has 4 microphones (m = 4), how many cables in total?

connect.modelAnswer: (8m + 5) + (3m + 7) + (4m + 2) = 15m + 14. The 15m says 15 cables are needed for every microphone, and the 14 is the fixed number of extra cables needed no matter how many microphones there are. With m = 4, that is 15(4) + 14 = 74 cables.

exitTicket.explanation: 6x + 2x = 8x and 3 + 5 = 8, so the simplified expression is 8x + 8.
choiceFeedback: Adding 6x + 2x adds the coefficients — the exponent doesn't change. It stays 8x, not 8x².
The digits were pushed together. Combine like terms by adding: 6x + 2x = 8x and 3 + 5 = 8.
16x folds ALL the numbers into the x-term. Only 6x and 2x are like terms; 3 + 5 = 8 stays a constant.
hints: Find the two families: x-terms (6x and 2x) and constants (3 and 5). Only family members combine.
Add the x coefficients together, add the constants together, and keep the variable's power unchanged.
Start with 6x + 2x — add 6 + 2. Then combine 3 + 5 for the constant part.
exitTicket.explanationEs: 6x + 2x = 8x y 3 + 5 = 8, así que la expresión simplificada es 8x + 8.
choiceFeedbackEs: Sumar 6x + 2x suma los coeficientes — el exponente no cambia. Queda 8x, no 8x².
Los dígitos se pegaron uno al otro. Combina términos semejantes sumando: 6x + 2x = 8x y 3 + 5 = 8.
16x mete todos los números en el término con x. Solo 6x y 2x son términos semejantes; 3 + 5 = 8 se queda como constante.
hintsEs: Halla las dos familias: los términos con x (6x y 2x) y las constantes (3 y 5). Solo los miembros de una misma familia se combinan.
Suma los coeficientes de x, suma las constantes y deja la potencia de la variable sin cambio.
Empieza con 6x + 2x — suma 6 + 2. Luego combina 3 + 5 para la parte constante.

questions.explanation: Multiply the 5 by each term inside: 5 × x = 5x and 5 × 3 = 15.
questions.explanationEs: Multiplica el 5 por cada término de adentro: 5 × x = 5x y 5 × 3 = 15.

questions.stem: Which shows 6n + 18 factored using its GREATEST common factor?
questions.explanation: Check each option first. 6(n + 3), 3(2n + 6) and 2(3n + 9) all equal 6n + 18. So all three are correct factorings. But the question asks for the GREATEST common factor, and the GCF of 6 and 18 is 6.
questions.stemEs: ¿Cuál muestra 6n + 18 factorizado usando su MÁXIMO factor común?
questions.explanationEs: Revisa cada opción primero. 6(n + 3), 3(2n + 6) y 2(3n + 9) todas equivalen a 6n + 18. Así que las tres son factorizaciones correctas. Pero la pregunta pide el MÁXIMO factor común, y el máximo factor común de 6 y 18 es 6.
4 × 2y = 8y y 4 × 5 = 20, así que el resultado es 8y − 20.

questions.stemEs: Usa la propiedad distributiva para calcular 7 × 62 mentalmente: 7 × (60 + 2) = ?

items.meaning: Rewrite an expression in a shorter equivalent form by combining like
Terms with the same letter raised to the same power
To add or subtract terms with the same letter into one
To rewrite an expression in a shorter form
The number in front of a letter

steps: 1. Like Terms: Terms that share the exact same variable part and exponent (e.g. 4x and 2x)
2. Add or subtract the coefficients of like terms; keep the variable unchanged
3. Constants (numbers without variables) combine together separately
